Storage components are the guts of every item storage cell. You need one component per cell, and they come in four tiers: 1k, 4k, 16k, and 64k.

Each tier is 4x the capacity of the previous one. A 1k component holds 1024 bytes, a 4k holds 4096, and so on up to 65536 bytes for 64k. The byte cost per item type also scales: 1k uses 8 bytes per type, 4k uses 32, 16k uses 128, and 64k uses 512.

Craft them tier by tier. The 4k recipe needs a 1k, the 16k needs a 4k, and the 64k needs a 16k. Higher tiers also require Pure Certus Quartz Crystals and Printed Calculation Circuits.

§ePS:§f Craft 1k components first and upgrade them. Do not try to skip tiers.
